method: Static source and execution-path review; no sample or dependency was executed.

samples.reason: Browser-agent SDK implementing its documented browser automation APIs; exact official npm artifact and matching upstream source.
execution_paths: localBrowser -> launchChrome: resolves a configured or installed Chrome image, creates a temporary profile, spawns Chrome with CDP flags and polls loopback /json/version; cleanup removes only its temporary profile and terminates its own browser process. Sandbox and certificate-error options are retained as notable dual-use observations.

Stagehand.create -> CDP service-worker Runtime binding -> schema-validated JSON-RPC router: caller-selected browser actions, selectors, page scripts, screenshots, cookie read/write/clear, file upload and clipboard APIs. No hidden fixed data recipient was found.

The worker includes bundled Zod and AI-provider clients. Zod Function constructors build schema validators; atob/Base64 paths carry files/media rather than a concealed executable stage. Provider keys and model endpoints are configuration inputs for requested inference.
The offscreen heartbeat exchanges local extension messages to maintain service-worker liveness. It is not a remote beacon or OS persistence mechanism.
packaging: All eight nested ZIP members are byte-identical to dist/extension counterparts.
index.mjs.map contains all forty source contents; its localBrowser.ts is byte-identical to the referenced upstream commit.

samples.reason: JavaScript/TypeScript build plugin implementing normal executor, compiler, release and local-registry workflows; exact official npm artifact.
execution_paths: nodeExecutor resolves the configured build target and output, waits for build completion, forks a local loader with NX_FILE_TO_RUN and NX_MAPPINGS, forwards output and stops previous children during watch restarts. Its event.value is the async build iterator result, not browser form input.
Node loaders use Function to preserve dynamic import semantics and Module._load overrides to map workspace libraries to built outputs. They run the configured project output.

release-publish checks local package metadata, registry/tag settings, dry-run status and existing published versions, then invokes the selected package manager to publish. It does not extract credentials to an unrelated destination.

verdaccioExecutor forks the locally installed Verdaccio CLI, sets npm/yarn registry and local test-token configuration, and registers cleanup to restore the previous settings. Clearing storage is explicitly configured local-registry cleanup.
The TypeScript plugin resolves workspace TypeScript, constructs project/tsconfig dependencies and writes its cache via a temporary file and rename. No additional payload was found.
packaging: Fetched nx core 23.3.0-beta.4: post-install asserts native-platform support and conditionally updates the Nx Cloud client only for a main Nx install in a configured Nx workspace using cloud. The updater contacts the configured Nx service (default cloud.nx.app), extracts its client bundle into the Nx cache, and loads that client. This is a visible configured updater, not concealed credential theft.

provenance.originals: Both samples match the SHA-256 of freshly fetched official npm releases; registry metadata identifies GitHub Actions publishing.
provenance.dependencies: Fetched all 33 unique direct runtime dependencies and nx core, preserving .forage.json; inspected manifests and code paths, and scanned seven major SDK/core dependencies. No hostile or suspicious dependency traits were emitted in those scans.
provenance.limits: Unpinned ranges resolve to current satisfying releases; this cannot reconstruct an unknown historical installation. Browserbase SDK recovery used unpkg reconstruction, not the original tarball. The two requested original archives were recovered byte-for-byte.

Existing live payment/OTP capture and DOM edit fixtures retain their findings.

Official Yarn 1.22.22 cli.js retains both identity traits.
Registry-only near miss keeps both neutral observations without Yarn identity.

rule_changes.change: Replace the line-leading heuristic with a parsed bare describe call in source syntax, now notable as a specific non-universal source observation; require that call plus a test filename for describe-suite-test-file, and update its Telegram exclusion consumer. Zod method declarations no longer count as test calls; actual Nx EJS suite calls remain detected.
controls: Original Zod declarations in Stagehand establish the false match.
Schema method-declaration near miss; actual suite invocation and existing assertion-tests.js positive.
Original Nx EJS test template retains a describe-suite source-form observation.

context_missing: No machine deployment, caller inputs, browser profile contents, runtime credentials, model-provider configuration or authorization history was supplied. These APIs could be abused, but the artifacts provide affirmative evidence of ordinary SDK/build-tool behavior rather than a concealed attack.
external_label_explanation: The source did not supply its rationale. Broad debugger/all-site browser permissions, cookie/screenshot/script APIs, process creation and package-registry changes are plausible heuristic triggers; this is an inference, not an attribution of the source verdict.
analysis_limits: Source facts and scans report incomplete flow projections, so relevant effects were traced in the source directly. Atomscan also warns that its v18 model feature schema predates v21 features. Neither missing detections nor the model score was used to establish benign behavior.
remaining_disagreements: No hostile/suspicious findings in either original archive or its members before or after; both calibrated classifier gates remain benign. The external hostile labels disagree with this behavior-based review. No hostile or suspicious coverage was lost.
